content: बन्धन {%a.%} .²1 Binding, fettering. .²2 Checking, stopping. .²3 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Dependent upon; <ab>cf.</ab> निबन्धन. .{@-नम्@} [बन्ध्-भावे-ल्युट्] .²1 The act of binding, fastening, tying; स्मरसि स्मर मेखलागुणैरुत गोत्रस्खलितेषु बन्धनम् <ls>Ku. 4. 8</ls>. .²2 Binding on or round, throwing round, clasping; विनम्रशाखाभुजबन्धनानि <ls>Ku. 3. 39</ls>; <ls>Pt. 5. 21</ls>; घटय भुजबन्धनम् <ls>Gīt. 10</ls>; <ls>R. 19. 17</ls>. .²3 A bond, tie (<ab>fig.</ab> also); <ls>R. 12. 76</ls>; आशाबन्धनम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 Fettering, chaining, confining. गजभुजङ्गमयोरपि बन्धनम् <ls>Bh. 2. 91</ls>. .²5 A chain, fetter, tether, halter <ab>&c.</ab> .²6 Capturing, catching. .²7 Bondage, confinement, imprisonment, captivity; as in बन्धनागार. .²8 A place of confinement, prison, jail; वसुदेवस्य देवक्यां जातो भोजेन्द्रबन्धने <ls>Bhāg. 3. 2. 25</ls>; त्वां कारयामि कमलोदरबन्धनस्थम् <ls>Ś. 6. 20</ls>; द्विगुणं त्रिगुणं पश्चाद्यावज्जीवं तु बन्धनम् <ls>Śukra. 4. 80</ls>; <ls>Ms. 9. 288</ls>. .²9 Forming, building, construction; सेतुबन्धनम् <ls>Ku. 4. 6</ls>. .²10 Connecting, uniting, joining. .²11 Hurting, injuring. .²12 A stalk, stem, peduncle (of a flower); कृतं न कर्णार्पितबन्धनं सखे <ls>Ś. 6. 18</ls>; <ls>U. 2. 9</ls>; <ls>Ku. 4. 14</ls>. .²13 A sinew, muscle; संधिन्नसंधिः प्रविकीर्णबन्धनो हतः क्षितौ वायुसुतेन राक्षसः <ls>Rām. 5. 47. 36</ls>, <ls n="Rām.">5. 24. 40</ls>. .²14 A bandage. .²15 A bar, barrier. .²16 Alloyage, mixing. .²17 An embankment, a bridge. .²18 A conjunction, connection. .²19 (In <ab>phil.</ab>) Mundane bondage (<ab>opp.</ab> to liberation). .{@-नम्, -नी@} .²1 A bond, tie. .²2 A rope, cord. .²3 A string, thread. .²4 A chain, fetter. .²5 A bondage.
